description: Practice questions, exam facts & study guides for professional certification exams.
summary: Practice questions, exam facts & study guides for professional certification exams.
offersHint: Practice questions, exam facts & study guides for professional certification exams. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://examova.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_certifications
toolsPreview.description: List the certifications Examova offers (e.g. CIPS Level 4, PMP, Business English) with a short description and how many practice questions each has. Use this first to see what is available.

toolsPreview.name: get_exam_info
toolsPreview.description: Get current public exam information and module links for a certification. Assessment details may vary by module.

toolsPreview.name: search_practice_questions
toolsPreview.description: Return curated Examova public-preview practice questions for a certification, optionally filtered by keyword. Use to quiz the user. Returns the question, options, and correct answer letter — full explanations and the complete question bank require an Examova account.

toolsPreview.name: get_study_guide
toolsPreview.description: Get Examova study guides / articles for a certification (optionally by topic). Returns titles, summaries, and links to free public guides on the Examova blog.

toolsPreview.name: get_signup_link
toolsPreview.description: Get the links to start using Examova — free demo exam, free account (5 questions/day), and Pro pricing.
